newsitem.title: UK: Sonatrach raises Jan LPG prices to $365/$320 a ton.
newsitem.headline: Sonatrach raises Jan LPG prices to $365/$320 a ton.

text.p: Algerian state oil and gas company Sonatrach has raised its prices for Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) by $35 a tonne for propane and $15 a tonne for butane.
The propane price for January is $365 a tonne fob Bethioua, up from $330 a tonne in December.
Butane is now priced at $320 a tonne fob Bethioua, up from $305 a tonne in December.
As usual, prices fob Arzew or Skikda are $7 a tonne higher than at Bethioua.

Saudi sources said on Thursday morning that it cannot yet officially confirm the Saudi CP for January. And British Petroleum Co Plc (BP) will not be publishing its Agreed Price (BPAP) on Thursday, and may delay it until Monday, the company said.
